checkpoint: fresh-state emptiness, fresh-context 401, expired-session 401s, and timed no-loop URL/state samples
provenance: transcribed verbatim from run-session captures; the two expired-token 401 response bodies are also retained as committed files under retained_api_responses/

attribution.frontend: Next.js dev server http://localhost:18118, node v20.19.6
attribution.browser: ZCode in-app browser (Chromium), single browser instance; freshness was produced by clearing storage + opening a new tab, NOT a separate browser profile

seam_description_correction: The fresh browser context was produced by clearing all cookies + localStorage + sessionStorage via page JavaScript, closing the tab, and opening a NEW TAB whose storage was verified empty before any protected-route visit. No separate OS-level or browser-profile-level fresh installation was created. All other wording in earlier records should be read with this description.

fresh_state_emptiness_record.when: after clearing storage and opening the new tab, before any protected-route visit
fresh_state_emptiness_record.note: document.cookie only exposes non-httpOnly cookies; the follow-up /api/auth/me 401 with credentials:include proves no httpOnly session material survived either

expired_session_records.seam: controlled negative injection: expired-but-correctly-signed JWT minted by the backend's own core.auth.create_access_token(expires_delta=-60s) using the scratch process's own SECRET_KEY for the test user's sub; injected mirroring the app's own storage shape (localStorage auth_token/token + JS-set cookies auth_token, next-auth.session-token, path=/, max-age=86400)
expired_session_records.privacy: token bytes and SECRET_KEY are private to the scratch world; token is recorded only as SHA-256 + decoded claims
expired_session_records.corroborating_log_lines: the sanitized access-log excerpt contains GET /api/auth/me 401 lines from both the fresh-context probe and the expired-session window

timed_no_loop_samples.method: location.href + page state sampled every 1s for 10s after visiting /dashboard with the injected expired session
timed_no_loop_samples.reading: exactly one navigation transition (t=5s -> t=6s), then a stable usable login page for the remaining window; no redirect/retry loop
timed_no_loop_samples.honest_limit: sampling was 1s over a 10s window; a sub-second oscillation between samples cannot be excluded, and the final reauthentication (checkpoint_identity_auth_me.json phase2) demonstrates the loop did not persist

screenshots_note: 04_fresh_context_protected_route_login.png and 06_expired_session_recovered_to_login.png are intentionally byte-identical (same sha256) because both episodes end on the same /login?callbackUrl=... render; they are visual state evidence for two separate episodes and are NOT independent proof of either. The decisive records for the two episodes are the emptiness+401 record and the timed samples above.
